title: 9.0.2 | Bugfix Patch
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/7f81621b8444c9823503fc73e98c2ec04f55bf3b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]The Animatronic Add-Ons[/b][/h3][p]• [b]Security Guard’s Badge
[/b]Decreased effect to 25% [i](was 50%)[/i][/p][p]• [b]Streamers
[/b]Decreased effect to 15% [i](was 20%)[/i][/p][p]• [b]Party Hat
[/b]Increased duration to -20%[i] (was -50%)[/i][/p][p]• [b]Bonnie’s Guitar Strings
[/b]Decreased undetectable duration to -100% [i](was -50%)[/i][/p][p]• [b]Foxy’s Hook
[/b]Increased duration to 6 seconds[i] (was 3s)[/i][/p][p]• [b]Endo CPU
[/b]Increased break speeds to 40% [i](was 25%)[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][b]Anniversary Event[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Dark Lord can no longer see Invitation Orbs of Survivors while in Bat form.[/p][/*][*][p]The VFX of the ''Endure any Stun'' Ability no longer triggers when the Killer is stunned by Decisive Strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the remote hook SFX to remains active when the killer holds the ability then looks away from a hook.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused The Ghoul to be missing its grunts at the start of the Trial when using the Legendary Outfit Rize Kamishiro.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the male and female breathing SFX played simultaneously when switching from The Legion's Subliminal Menace (Frank) customization to any female Legion customization.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bots[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Survivor Bots to be unable to rotate their camera vertically.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Survivor Bots to stay stuck trying to reveal the Animatronic when below or over the Security Door.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Characters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the Survivor's left arm pointing emote to not animate properly.[/p][/*][*][p]The Nightmare's Dream Pallets now consistently play the rupturing animation in the POV of Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]The Artist's Dire crow acceleration speed is now consistent when fired at different angles.[/p][/*][*][p]The Artist's Dire crow projectiles no longer miss moving survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]The Artist's Dire crows now correctly reduce a health state on a survivor with a swarm, instead of triggering killer instinct.[/p][/*][*][p]The Artist no longer jitters when pressing the Power Button twice in quick succession.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing M2 multiple times as The Artist no longer causes stuttering for the killer's power.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ghoul can no longer use another "Kagune Leap" after being pallet stunned while performing a "grab-attack".[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors are no longer temporarily stuck in an animation while dropping a pallet during The Ghoul's grab-attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Ghoul's Enraged Mode bonus cooldown was not applied to any actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where occasionally The Ghoul's camera POV moved rapidly and aggressively when grabbing Survivors with the power.[/p][/*][*][p]The Nurse no longer stutters when blinks are cancelled by the Server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Legion did not lose equipped add-ons after a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph was invisible during the idle animation with the Deep Sea outfit equipped on low graphic settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Animatronic[/b][/p][list][*][p]Security Door enter animation/audio now plays for the Killer when a Survivor enters a security door, regardless of Killer's facing direction.[/p][/*][*][p]The Animatronic's Oblivious and Broken Icons now appear when spectating a Survivor affected by the "Office Phone" add-on.[/p][/*][*][p]The Animatronic's Axe Grab power icon no longer stays dim and transparent while in range as the Spectator.[/p][/*][*][p]The Killer can now perform the "Grab Axe" animation when affected Survivors drop their equipped item[/p][/*][*][p]The Animatronic's "Camera disabled" text no longer stays after Security Camera is enabled.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue to prevent Survivors being able to stand on the bench and chandelier in the Father Campbell's Chapel map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in The Macmillan Estate Realm where an invisible collision around the shack prevented players navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in The Suffocation Pit map where The Knight's guard would have issue navigating a ramp[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Treatment Theatre where the Knight's guard would have issues vaulting windows[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in The Macmillan Estate Realm where a placeholder tile would spawn in the maps[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues in The Underground Complex where The Nightmare could not launch its powers through some walls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Haddonfield where The Animatronics could not interrupt a survivor when interacting with the security room door[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the wrong percentage to be shown in Up The Ante's description.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Platforms[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Steam players to be stuck on the Initialization screen when joining a match[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quests[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Rift Pass / Week6 / Be Chased FOR 200 SECONDS to be unable to complete.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Challenge 'I want it, I got it' in Tome 15 to be unable to complete.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Chase music is missing for Survivor POV when being chased by Victor. The previous fix done for the Chapter 9.0.1 Hot Fix 1 release has been reverted whilst this issue is being addressed[/p][/*][*][p]The Animatronic can be blinded during the Security Room interrupt grab.[/p][/*][/list]
